rundown: Cavaliers beat Musketeers 83-71 at Imperial Arena in Nassau, Bahamas. Cavaliers led 42-27 at half-time and never looked back.
Leading the way — Cavaliers: Sam Lewis 21 pts; Chance Mallory 9 ast; Thijs De Ridder 10 reb. Musketeers: Mike Nwoko 15 pts; Filip Borovicanin 3 ast, 8 reb.
Where Cavaliers won it: they shot 51% to 39%, shot 40% from three to 23% and won the boards 46-26.
Against the closing line (Draft Kings): Cavaliers closed as 6.5-point favorites and covered by 5.5; the total closed at 153.5 and they combined for 154, over by 0.5.

review.title: The algo's call
review.body:
Logged before the start, last snapshot Nov 27, 10:55 AM ET. It had Cavaliers 72% and Musketeers 28%, projecting Cavaliers 78.9 – Musketeers 72.7 (151.6 total, Cavaliers by 6.3).

Final: Cavaliers 83 – Musketeers 71. Right winner: it had Cavaliers at 72%.

review.title: How the ratings held up
review.body:
Cavaliers came in with a 13% above average attack and a 10% stingier than average defense (8-0, 88.4 scored and 66 allowed a game over 8 games), worth about 206 and 206 games of evidence. Projected to score 78.9, they scored 83 (+4.1 points, 5% over); projected to allow 72.7, they allowed 71 (−1.7 points, 2% under).

Musketeers came in with a 7% above average attack and a 9% stingier than average defense (6-1, 83.1 scored and 65.1 allowed a game over 7 games), worth about 199 and 199 games of evidence. Projected to score 72.7, they scored 71 (−1.7 points, 2% under); projected to allow 78.9, they allowed 83 (+4.1 points, 5% over).

The bigger miss was Cavaliers' scoring (+4.1 points against projection).

review.title: Where the result sat in the simulations
review.body:
Total: 154 against 151.6 projected (+2.4), about the 57th percentile of the simulated totals (a typical game swings ±14.5).

Margin: Cavaliers by 12 against Cavaliers by 6.3 projected, about the 30th percentile of the simulated margins (typical swing ±11).

An ordinary result: inside the range the simulations expected most of the time.

review.title: Situational factors, checked
review.body: Market (Line movement signal): Musketeers ×1.02, Cavaliers ×1.00. It favored Musketeers, who did not beat their projection by more than the other side did.

review.title: Against the market
review.body:
XAV ML (+240) at +240: the algo gave it 28% vs 28% fair (+0 pts) — lost (-1u); lost to the close (closing fair chance 28%). UVA ML (-298) at -298: the algo gave it 72% vs 72% fair (0 pts) — won (+0.3u); lost to the close (closing fair chance 72%). XAV +6.5 (-110) at -110: the algo gave it 50% vs 50% fair (+0 pts) — lost (-1u); same number as the close. UVA -6.5 (-110) at -110: the algo gave it 50% vs 50% fair (0 pts) — won (+0.9u); same number as the close. OVER 154.5 (-110) at -110: the algo gave it 50% vs 50% fair (-0.4 pts) — lost (-1u); lost to the closing 153.5 by 1. UNDER 154.5 (-110) at -110: the algo gave it 50% vs 50% fair (+0.4 pts) — won (+0.9u); beat the closing 153.5 by 1.

From the algo's snapshot to the close: total 154.5 → 153.5. The total moved toward the algo's number.

No bet: nothing cleared the algo's bar before the game.

review.title: Where the public and the money were
review.body:
Splits (Action Network): spread: 59% of bets on Cavaliers, 53% of the money — Cavaliers covered; total: 65% of bets on the over, 62% of the money — it went under; moneyline: 94% of bets on Cavaliers, 93% of the money.

The sharp side by the algo's read was Musketeers, who lost and didn't cover.

review.title: What could have made it wrong
review.body:
Flagged going in: early-season numbers were thin.

The projection landed within its normal range anyway, so the flags didn't cost it much this time.

review.title: What the algo learns
review.body:
This game's own lesson: scoring came in at ×0.993 of the raw projection. It counts toward CBB scoring level, home edge and both teams' attack and defense corrections.

Across 1197 graded CBB games the algo now scales scoring ×0.978 and gives home teams +1.1 points. Team corrections so far: Cavaliers attack ×1.014, defense ×0.982 (8 games); Musketeers attack ×0.989, defense ×1.000 (7 games).

review.title: Bottom line
review.body: Right side, total within its normal range, margin within its normal range, no bet.
